body.name: \(q\)-state double-triangular latent causal measurement class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)=\{(G,P): (G,P)\text{ satisfies the measurement-graph, Markov, faithfulness, positive-latent-support, measurement-nondegeneracy, categorical double-triangular, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions for fixed }q,K,J\}\).
